lib.t: PSX Character Library v1.4: Foxhole added
lib.b:
Foxhole is in the Library: 14 Second World War soldiers of four armies, American, British, German and Soviet, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 18 packs and 251 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Foxhole has its own new archive, Wars of the Past (215 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other six archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 18 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.4.0:

  • Added Foxhole: 14 PSX WW2 Soldiers, Allied and Axis: US rifleman, German rifleman, British rifleman, Soviet rifleman, US sergeant, German machine gunner, Soviet sniper, British officer, US paratrooper, German squad leader, Soviet tank crewman, British commando, US medic, Soviet field medic.
  • New genre archive: Wars of the Past. Every future wars of the past pack joins it.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 18 packs and 251 characters.

Foxhole is also sold on the Fort Vale page, together with Fort Vale, Crosstown, Ashfall and Syndicate: https://csaf.itch.io/fort-vale-psx-soldiers

How we tested it: every file in the seven archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (2626 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 304 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: $19.99 today. It rises for new buyers as the Library grows: $24.99 at 19 packs, $29.99 at 22. The next pack makes 19, so that first step is close. Each step gets its own devlog here at least five days ahead, with the date. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 20 live PSX pages, 7 of them sold, 28 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.

smp.t: PSX Characters Sampler v1.10: 18 free characters, the British rifleman joins
smp.b:
New in 1.10.0: the British rifleman from Foxhole joins the free PSX Characters Sampler, which now has 18 characters, one from each of our eighteen paid PSX packs.

Blackwater and Camp Redfern are sold on the Last Shift page, all three casts in one purchase; Saint Oswin is sold on the Hollow Congregation page, both casts in one purchase; Crosstown, Ashfall, Syndicate and Foxhole are sold on the Fort Vale page, all five casts in one purchase; Hollyfrost is sold on the Greyhollow page, both casts in one purchase. Each of those pages also has its own free sampler file for each cast.

Every character comes with the same files its full pack ships: a GLB with all 45 animation clips and the reference T pose, a GLB per extra skin, FBX with clips, OBJ, 256 px textures and the Blender source. Across the eighteen that is 55 skins. Each file is byte for byte the one in the paid pack.

We ran the tests again on the new download: a blank Godot 4.7.2 project imported every GLB, the PSX shader compiled on all 18 characters under Forward+, Compatibility and Mobile, and Blender imported every FBX (all 53 bones and every clip) and every OBJ back in. Unity and Unreal were not run here.

The full packs: Last Shift + Blackwater + Camp Redfern (41 characters, $9.99), Ironvale (14 characters, $7.99), Hollow Congregation + Saint Oswin (28 characters, $8.99), Fort Vale + Crosstown + Ashfall + Syndicate + Foxhole (70 characters, $9.99), Greyhollow + Hollyfrost (28 characters, $8.99), Deep Station (14 characters, $7.99), Pale Hours (14 characters, $7.99), Outpost (14 characters, $7.99), Grimsnout (14 characters, $7.99), Night Beat (14 characters, $7.99). Those are list prices: as we post this, seven of the ten pages are 30% off (Last Shift + Blackwater + Camp Redfern $6.99, Ironvale $5.59, Hollow Congregation + Saint Oswin $6.29, Greyhollow + Hollyfrost $6.29, Deep Station $5.59, Pale Hours $5.59, Grimsnout $5.59).

Every character was made with AI tools: bodies built by scripts an AI system wrote, textures painted by AI image models and projected onto the mesh.
